slides.h: When did you last laugh [[out loud]] at a screen?
slides.dek: Five comedies built for real laughs, ranked by how fast the first one lands.

items.title: Nichijou
items.note: School life animated like an action film. The hardest-hitting single gags in the medium.

items.title: KonoSuba
items.note: Every party member is the worst person available. Funny for three straight seasons.

items.title: The Way of the Househusband
items.note: A yakuza legend takes on housework. Episodes are minutes long.

items.title: Grand Blue
items.note: A college diving club at full volume. Three seasons of terrible decisions.

items.title: Daily Lives of High School Boys
items.note: Sketch comedy. Any episode, any order, same result.

slides.label: The test
slides.h: A comedy owes you [[one thing]]: the laugh.
body: Three real laughs in the first episode or it drops off this list. All five up top clear that bar inside twenty minutes, and none of them ask for homework first.

slides.body: Pick one for tonight, then report back in the comments. Save the list for a flat evening.
